description: OpenClaw plugin for TruCore ATF. Provides thirteen typed tools for agent discovery, health, bootstrap, intent protection, receipt verification, savings reporting, integration doctor, preflight, explain, billing, and adoption advising. Version 0.2.3 adds a recursive schema guard and fixes three nested object-schema issues for strict gateway compatibility.

tools.name: atf_health
tools.description: Check ATF CLI and API backend availability. Returns health status and dependency checks.

tools.name: atf_discover
tools.description: Fetch and parse /.well-known/atf.json to confirm ATF is reachable and return manifest fields.

tools.name: atf_bootstrap_plan
tools.description: Plan a bootstrap recipe (dry-run). Returns the ordered step list without executing anything.

tools.name: atf_bootstrap_execute_safe
tools.description: Execute only the safe steps of a recipe (env + verify kinds). Never runs cli steps that require network or signer access.

tools.name: atf_protect_intent
tools.description: Submit an agent intent to ATF for policy evaluation. Returns a permit or denial receipt.

tools.name: atf_verify_receipt
tools.description: Run local deterministic hash verification on a receipt to confirm it has not been tampered with.

tools.name: atf_report_savings
tools.description: Aggregate local receipt files and generate a receipt-backed savings or losses-prevented report.

tools.name: atf_integration_doctor
tools.description: Run ATF integration readiness check. Reports plugin loading status, config validity, and backend connectivity.

tools.name: atf_bot_preflight
tools.description: Pre-session readiness check: is ATF ready to protect intents right now? Confirms CLI, policy, and network are operational.

tools.name: atf_tx_explain
tools.description: Explain an ATF deny decision or receipt in human terms. Returns reason codes, policy triggers, and remediation suggestions.

tools.name: atf_billing_info
tools.description: Retrieve current billing status, plan tier, and usage metrics for the active ATF account.

tools.name: atf_adoption_advisor
tools.description: Analyze current agent configuration and recommend next steps to improve ATF coverage, policy completeness, and receipt hygiene.

config_path.description: Path to the agent ATF config file (optional, auto-detected if omitted)

tools.name: atf_billing_claim
tools.description: Submit a billing claim for verified savings generated by ATF policy enforcement. Attaches receipt evidence.

receipts_dir.description: Path to local receipts directory containing denial receipts with savings metadata
